lines.text: After the nation finished crossing, the LORD told Joshua to choose twelve men, one from each tribe, to take twelve stones from the Jordan.
Joshua said the stones would be a memorial, and the Israelites carried twelve stones from the Jordan to the camp.
Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, and the priests with the ark crossed after the people finished.
The Reubenites, the Gadites, and half of Manasseh crossed armed for battle, and the LORD exalted Joshua as Israel had revered Aaron.
When the priests' feet touched dry land, the waters returned, and the people camped at Shittim on the eastern border of Jericho.
